answer: The jamu stall holds roots and rhizomes, turmeric and ginger in baskets. Proof of jamu-maker via herbal tonic tally — a tonic the jamu-maker brews only after 34 tonics steep true without one turning cloudy at the strain, each brewed by the jamu-maker herself. crystal grates the turmeric fine and drops it in the clay pot. harbor simmers the brew slow and skims the foam off. cedar strains the tonic and bottles it while warm. Thirty-four tonics must steep true without one tonic turning cloudy at the strain, and the next still clouds where the cloth was folded thin.
